units.source_text: “为了使杉树长好，用刀把多余的枝丫砍掉。

en.t: To make the cedars grow well, they cut away the extra branches with knives.

units.source_text: 人们有时还要使用梯子，有时则像猴子一般从这棵杉树梢荡到另一棵杉树梢……”

en.t: Sometimes they even use ladders, and sometimes they swing like monkeys from the top of one cedar to the top of another...
